# FLX-5011: the committed statistic was formed under different declarations

**Family:** numerics (the 5000 band)

SEAM-FIDELITY-SPEC §8: a change to anything other than a tolerance, a minVariance or budget.maxStateAge moves G, and a statistic committed under the old G no longer answers for the new declarations. A new committed state is required before the fidelity check can run again.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-5011
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
